_comment: resolveVendorStandReturnState({ attemptId, loadOrderStatus }) golden matrix. loadOrderStatus(attemptId) is injected and returns the stored vendorStandOrders.status string, or null/undefined when no order carries that attemptId, or throws. The resolver takes NO status from the request: the only inputs are the attempt id and the loader. Output is exactly one of paid | pending | not-completed.

cases.note: no order carries this attempt id (unknown, or superseded by a newer attempt)
unknown status string fails to the retry copy, never to paid
a transient read failure must never tell a possibly-paid vendor to pay again; neutral copy
